title: Trip Date Chain
description: Stops a hotel being booked for the wrong night by drawing each stay as a bar on a night-by-night strip under the flights, catching a 00:50 landing with the room booked from that date, nights paid before a +1 arrival, gap nights, double-booked nights and a room kept past a 00:35 departure, sliding the stay's bar to the right dates in one tap with Undo, and reading a small-hours departure back as the evening before.
stops: Hotel booked for the wrong night
mistakes: landed after midnight no hotel room
hotel booked a day late after overnight flight
